governance.attested_by: ercot144 coal per-plant offer session 2026-07-31 (owner charter: the ERCOT-144 DOF-retirement lane 'serving C6', issued with the session instruction to bring ERCOT to a calibrated-with-caveats determination; precommit docs/PRECOMMIT-ercot144-coal-perplant-offer-2026-07-31.md pushed before the solve). BASIS FOR THE ATTESTATION, stated so it is auditable: (1) the C6 blocker named by the charter — 8 residual-identified DOF entries in the keeper ledger — is retired to 6 by MEASURED REPLACEMENT, not by re-labeling: coal_perplant_offer_level reprices every CAMPD coal committed/econ tranche onto its own plant's merged modal 60-Day SCED Submitted TPO curve (verbatim disclosure conduct, zero fitted parameters, frozen derive scripts/data/derive_coal_perplant_offer.py), replacing the COAL_* offer_curve_by_group multipliers (25 scalars, STRIPPED from this run's config) and the COAL_SIGMOID_DEFAULTS[ERCOT] gas-keyed sigmoids (disarmed) — the largest fitted surface in the audit's class-C table (C-1); coal_take_or_pay_tranches is retired as a CAMPD-config false positive (the ScenarioConfig.coal_tranche_* fields are consumed only by the legacy split_coal_tranches path, dead code under use_campd_bins — the builder's C-12 precedent). (2) Every structural lever in this run traces to a measured/published input: coal mustrun = ERCOT-137 measured margin, coal mid-band = ERCOT-144 per-plant measured curves, coal peak = ERCOT-140 measured gas-parity margin, CC committed = ERCOT-139 measured level, gas margin/cleared-share surfaces = measured SCED/DAM conduct, availability = measured DAM envelope, outages = historic CAMPD windows (exogenous), fuel = F923/EP measured. (3) The remaining 6 residual entries are the rule-1-sanctioned offer-curve scope shared by every CALIBRATED keeper (offer_curve_by_group gas bands, smoothing shape) plus wefor pair / battery adder / merchant-CHP share, each carrying its open root-cause issue in this ledger (audit_keepers E8) — the same profile under which CAISO/PJM/MISO/NYISO/NEISO attest C6. (4) No lever in this run was fitted to a price residual and no output is pinned to actuals: the one mechanism this run adds was identified from submitted-offer disclosure only, its pre-registered guards (zero-spurious, C3c no-drain, C1/C2 held) all PASS, and the C3a/C3b improvements were not tuning targets (rule 1 [R-STRUCT]).

exceptions.metric: hours RT hourly hub LMP > $200/MWh (C3c scarcity tail)
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (probabilistic real-time scarcity premium above the measured reserve/outage envelope — outside hourly perfect-foresight LP representation; in-model queue adjudicated empty)
exceptions.reason: ADOPTED LEDGER (owner charter, ERCOT-144 2026-07-31 — the mechanism-matrix §5.1 queue item 2 closure route: 'C6 governance attestation of the C3c tail as an attributed measured-input limitation (ERCOT-101/107/108 adjudication)', unblocked by the DOF retirement this bundle carries). ERCOT's C3c residual is the same object the MISO, NEISO and CAISO ledgers name: the probabilistic real-time scarcity premium (ORDC price formation over 10-30-min net-load, outage and reserve uncertainty) that a deterministic realized-weather hourly LP does not contain. The in-model lever queue is adjudicated EMPTY on every route: ERCOT-99 closed the gas-offer-wall reach, ERCOT-101/102 attributed the >$200 tail as a measured-input bound, ERCOT-107/108 refuted the reserve-side family on the completed 2x2 (the online-capacity envelope is bistable; the span is not the confound; ~1.5 GW of the depth is measured commitment conduct), ERCOT-118/119 closed the gas econ rebasis (C3c drain), and ERCOT-140 measured the coal top onto its gas-parity level with C3c bit-unchanged. Hour-level corroboration on this bundle's own bytes: the model's sub-$200 price surface is within -5.1/+0.5/-4.5 % of the capped actual mean (2023/24/25, settlement basis incl. published RTORDPA/ORDC overlays), while the actual >$200 tail wedge is $18.61/$2.50/$0.63 per MWh of annual mean vs the model's $7.21/$0.51/$0.00 — the missing object is the RT premium's frequency, not the marginal-cost surface. Zero-spurious guard holds (2/2/0 spurious hours, unchanged from the ercot140 keeper): the model invents no tail it should not have.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (the annual-mean miss is carried by the C3c scarcity-formation object above, concentrated in high-load hours by the load weighting)
exceptions.reason: ADOPTED LEDGER (owner charter, ERCOT-144 2026-07-31; same attributed object as the price_tail entries — one limitation, surfacing in the annual mean through the tail hours' price mass). Decomposition measured this session on the committed actual_lmp_hourly_ERCOT.parquet vs this bundle's settlement hub series: capped at the $200 tail threshold, the model's mean is within -5.1 % (2023), +0.5 % (2024) and -4.5 % (2025) of the capped actual — commercial-grade on the sub-tail surface — while the >$200 tail carries $18.61 (38.5 % of the actual annual mean), $2.50 (9.3 %) and $0.63 (2.0 %) per MWh, of which the model reproduces $7.21/$0.51/$0.00. The load-weighted official basis amplifies the same hours (scarcity concentrates at peak load), which is why the official C3a miss (-36.4/-14.8/-14.3 %) exceeds the unweighted decomposition (-26.7/-6.9/-6.4 %). The in-model price-level queue is closed: the coal offer surface is now measured end-to-end (ERCOT-137/144/140), the CC committed block is measured (ERCOT-139), the gas econ rebasis is rejected (ERCOT-118/119), the C3a trough lane is closed end-to-end (ERCOT-141), and the reserve-side family is refuted (ERCOT-107/108). No adder, haircut or value tuned to this residual is admissible (rules 1/13) — the remaining wedge is the un-modelled RT scarcity/reserve premium named by the price_tail entries.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (duration-curve top carried by the C3c scarcity-formation object; the NRMSE is tail-mass dominated)
exceptions.reason: ADOPTED LEDGER (owner charter, ERCOT-144 2026-07-31; same attributed object). The duration-curve NRMSE is dominated by the >$200 top of the curve the price_tail entries attribute (2023: actual 181 h reaching $5,000 vs model 47 h — the squared-error mass of the top percentile carries the 0.637; 2024: 53 h vs 6 h carries the 0.208), i.e. the same probabilistic RT scarcity formation outside hourly perfect-foresight representation. exceptions.metric: D-1 diurnal profile gates (profile_r >= 0.80, off-peak cv_ratio >= 0.50)
exceptions.magnitude: profile r 0.868 (PASSES the 0.80 gate), off-peak CV ratio 0.323 < 0.50
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT / REPRESENTATION LIMITATION (Oak Grove's overnight turndown is driven outside the offer surface — intra-zonal North congestion not representable in a 7-zone reduced network, or QSE self-schedule conduct with no rule-13-admissible representation; ERCOT-143 §5 adjudication)
exceptions.reason: ADOPTED LEDGER (owner charter, ERCOT-144 2026-07-31). The C7 COAL_LIGNITE cell is adjudicated CLOSED-UNREACHABLE by four independent refutations: ERCOT-142 (floor exonerated — COAL_MUSTRUN 808 MW is exactly the measured overnight floor and is not the pin; seasonal level split refuted; unit commitment refuted at unit grain — both units back down together; 'not price-following' refuted by robust within-day Spearman) and ERCOT-143 (the offer-slope object does not exist: Oak Grove's own submitted curve is a near-flat $9 line, spread $0.36, and the real plant sits at its LSL while offered $10-15 below the clearing price — a resource dispatched to LSL despite an in-merit offer is not being cleared on its energy offer; the drivers left are intra-zonal congestion, outside a 7-zone network and a closed topology family (ERCOT-117), or self-schedule/telemetry conduct, which fails rule 13's forward-analogue test outright). On this bundle the measured per-plant curve moves the profile-r leg PASSING (0.769 -> 0.868 > 0.80) — the accurate curve IMPROVES the shape correlation — while the off-peak CV leg reads 0.323: the model cannot reproduce the real plant's overnight variance without inventing a driver the market data says does not exist in the offer surface (pre-registered ex ante in the precommit: the accurate curve is more inframarginal overnight and may regress C7's variance leg; rule 14 keeps the accurate input). 2024/2025 COAL_LIGNITE pass both legs.
